node.title: L1 coarse p-free Wronskian distance packing
node.statement: For a finite-field n-set H, let Phi_free send each a-subset A to its p-free power sums through depth d<=a. Frobenius recovers equality of all moments through d inside any fiber. If distinct A,B in one fiber have disjoint tails X=A\B and Y=B\A of common size t, the locator Wronskian F_X'F_Y-F_XF_Y' is nonzero and has degree at most 2t-d-2, so t>=ceil((d+2)/2). Consequently every fiber has size at most floor(binom(n,s)/binom(a,s)), where s=a-ceil((d+2)/2)+1; for scalar L1 with a=k+d this is s=floor((a+k)/2). The half-depth distance is sharp over F_4. If a+k>=n, the cap is at least 2^(n-a), so under q<2^256 it cannot itself pay a cell with n-a>=128. This is a coarse-fiber statement: exact mixed/Pade prefixes already have the stronger tail bound d+1. It does not prove row-sharp Q, Pade-graph coalescing, or L1.
